podcast_name: Email Empire with Allison Hardy | Sell on autopilot with a strategic email funnel
episode_title: EP 498 | Why Every Entrepreneur Needs an Email Funnel (Yes, Even You!)
question: What are the four core components of an email funnel according to Allison Hardy?
transcript_excerpt: An email funnel has four pieces: a lead magnet that solves one specific problem in exchange for an email address; a nurture sequence of emails that builds trust and shifts how subscribers think about their problem; a timed offer introduced when the subscriber is most ready with an incentive to buy now; and a pitch sequence that introduces the offer and overcomes objections.

podcast_name: Email Empire with Allison Hardy | Sell on autopilot with a strategic email funnel
episode_title: EP 498 | Why Every Entrepreneur Needs an Email Funnel (Yes, Even You!)
question: Why does Allison Hardy recommend building an email funnel even if your email list is too small?
transcript_excerpt: An email funnel is what grows your email list and sells to it simultaneously. Ten email subscribers who walk through a great sequence are worth more than a thousand email subscribers who hear from you twice a year. The funnel itself is designed to acquire and nurture leads while converting them.

podcast_name: Email Empire with Allison Hardy | Sell on autopilot with a strategic email funnel
episode_title: EP 498 | Why Every Entrepreneur Needs an Email Funnel (Yes, Even You!)
question: What five reasons does Allison Hardy give for why every entrepreneur needs an email funnel?
transcript_excerpt: You own your email list unlike social platform followers; it sells while you live your life and generates predictable revenue; it turns hope into certainty with daily leads and sales; it builds trust at each buyer's pace without high-pressure tactics; and it provides data you can act on, showing opt-in rates, open rates, click rates, and which emails drive sales.

podcast_name: Email Empire with Allison Hardy | Sell on autopilot with a strategic email funnel
episode_title: EP 498 | Why Every Entrepreneur Needs an Email Funnel (Yes, Even You!)
question: What percentage of Allison Hardy's email list reported having a non-selling email funnel?
transcript_excerpt: 54% of her email list said they have an email funnel but it is not selling. This is the largest segment of her audience, which Hardy identifies as her sweet spot for helping people optimize existing funnels that are not yet generating revenue.
